notes: The editor now answers to the keyboard the way every video editor does. J, K and L shuttle backward, pause and forward, and tapping again ramps to two and four times speed. I and O set the in and out points at the playhead, so a clip can be trimmed without dragging its edge. Command C, V and D copy, paste and duplicate a clip, and Option with the arrow keys moves one earlier or later. Press the question mark key, or the button beside the timecode, to see all of it — including the shortcuts that were already there and never announced.
